observations: Four tires stacked on a motorcycle.
Manufacturer stickers are visible on the tread of at least two tires.
The sticker on the top tire clearly reads 'MICHELIN', 'Primacy SUV', and '265/65R17 112H'.
The tread pattern appears deep and unused.
A watermark 'LAGOS BEST TIRES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: set of Michelin Primacy SUV tires
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows four tires with matching Michelin Primacy SUV stickers.

risks.risk: Tires may be old stock; rubber degrades over time regardless of tread wear.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 4-digit DOT code (week and year of manufacture) on the sidewall of each tire.

risks.risk: Sidewall damage or structural defects not visible from the tread view.
risks.proof: Photos of the inner and outer sidewalls of all four tires.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the DOT date codes on the sidewalls of all four tires.
Photos showing the full sidewall of each tire to confirm embossed markings and check for damage.
response.reason: The brand, model, and size are clearly identified from the stickers in the photo. While the age is unknown, the item can be priced at its worst-case (old stock) value.
